svg.title: Verification & Account Flow - Email/Phone Verify + Cross-Channel Contact Change (M3)

g.text: Verification & Account Flow - Email/Phone Verify + Cross-Channel Contact Change (M3)
All endpoints below require a valid JWT (ApiInterceptor adds
the Bearer token). Cooldown (60s) and daily cap (5) violations
return 429 -> surface the uniform ErrorResponse message.
Verify a level (EMAIL first, then PHONE)
dev sender logs the code to the backend console;
smtp-pulse delivers it to the inbox. PHONE does the same
via DevSmsSender (console) or Twilio once credentials are set.
Re-requesting an already-verified level -> 409 (M2 guard on the
backend: no code is sent, no throttle consumed). Confirm is
idempotent. UX: treat 409 on request as "you are verified".
Contact change: email -> phone SMS proof (cross-channel)
backend sends the OTP to the CURRENT PHONE (SMS), NOT to the
new email - stealing the mailbox alone cannot change it.
duplicate new email -> 409; same as current -> 400;
sessions are NOT revoked by contact change (only a password
Contact change: phone -> email code proof (cross-channel)
backend sends the OTP to the CURRENT EMAIL - losing the SIM
alone cannot let an attacker re-route verification texts.
After any successful confirm the account page re-reads the
profile so the UI shows the new contact immediately.
